bullets.text: AI Dev Days Announced - Join Microsoft for a two-day virtual event on December 10-11 focused on AI innovations.
Windows 11 Insider Preview - New build 26220.7344 introduces native support for MCP, enhancing AI agent connectivity.
Gartner Magic Quadrant Leader - **Microsoft** recognized as a leader in email security for its innovative Defender for Office 365.
Cybersecurity Strategies - Prioritize essential cyber hygiene and modern security standards to combat evolving threats.
Xbox Game Pass Launch - **Clair Obscur: Expedition 33** becomes the biggest third-party launch in 2025.
Microsoft Store Awards Winners - Celebrating outstanding applications that enhance user experiences across the Windows ecosystem.
AI-Powered Azure Innovations - New Azure options enhance control and resilience for mission-critical workloads.
Accessibility Progress in 2025 - Microsoft highlights advancements in accessibility features based on community feedback.
Mistral Large 3 Launch - New open-source AI model available in Azure, designed for enterprise workloads.
Device-Bound Request Signing - Enhancing mobile security by linking requests to hardware-backed keys.
